examples.text_en: The old house was an enigma to the town.
examples.text_zh: 那座老房子对镇上的人来说是个谜。

examples.text_en: His long silence stayed an enigma for us.
examples.text_zh: 他长久的沉默对我们来说仍是个谜。

examples.text_en: The teacher will enjoin the children to stay inside.
examples.text_zh: 老师会吩咐孩子们待在屋里。

examples.text_en: They enjoin us to keep the old rules.
examples.text_zh: 他们吩咐我们要遵守旧规矩。

examples.text_en: The book will enlighten us about the old world.
examples.text_zh: 这本书会启发我们去了解旧时的世界。

examples.text_en: He tried to enlighten the young people in class.
examples.text_zh: 他设法在课上启发年轻人。

examples.text_en: The talk was enlightening and full of good ideas.
examples.text_zh: 这次谈话很有启发，满是好想法。

examples.text_en: It was an enlightening day for the whole team.
examples.text_zh: 对全队来说，这是很有启发的一天。

examples.text_en: The old book brought enlightenment to many people.
examples.text_zh: 这本旧书给许多人带来了启迪。

examples.text_en: He found enlightenment in the words of a friend.
examples.text_zh: 他从朋友的话里得到了启发。

examples.text_en: They will enlist young men for the long work.
examples.text_zh: 他们将为这项长期工作招募年轻人。

examples.text_en: He tried to enlist our help for the new plan.
examples.text_zh: 他设法为这个新计划争取我们的帮助。

examples.text_en: A little music can enliven the whole party.
examples.text_zh: 一点音乐就能让整个聚会活跃起来。

examples.text_en: He told a joke to enliven the long meeting.
examples.text_zh: 他讲了个笑话，让漫长的会议活跃起来。

examples.text_en: The fine net would enmesh the small fish.
examples.text_zh: 细密的网会缠住那些小鱼。

examples.text_en: He did not want to enmesh us in his fight.
examples.text_zh: 他不想让我们卷入他的争斗。

examples.text_en: There was deep enmity between the groups.
examples.text_zh: 这两个群体之间曾有很深的敌意。

examples.text_en: Their old enmity was known to everyone here.
examples.text_zh: 他们之间的旧怨这里人人都知道。

examples.text_en: The king will ennoble him for his great work.
examples.text_zh: 国王将因他的功绩授予他爵位。

examples.text_en: Hard work can ennoble a man in the eyes of all.
examples.text_zh: 辛勤的劳动能让一个人在众人眼中变得高贵。

examples.text_en: A long quiet day can bring a deep ennui.
examples.text_zh: 漫长安静的一天会带来深深的倦怠。

examples.text_en: He felt a strange ennui in the new city.
examples.text_zh: 他在新城感到一种莫名的厌倦。

examples.text_en: The enormity of the loss was hard to take.
examples.text_zh: 损失之大让人难以接受。

examples.text_en: They spoke about the enormity of the old war.
examples.text_zh: 他们谈起那场旧战争的惨烈。

examples.text_en: She came to enquire about the new school.
examples.text_zh: 她来打听这所新学校的情况。

examples.text_en: We must enquire at the office for the facts.
examples.text_zh: 我们必须到办公室去问明情况。

examples.text_en: He made an enquiry about the lost book.
examples.text_zh: 他询问了那本丢失的书。

examples.text_en: Her enquiry brought a quick and kind answer.
examples.text_zh: 她的询问很快得到了友善的回答。

examples.text_en: The bad news would enrage the old man.
examples.text_zh: 这个坏消息会让老人暴怒。

examples.text_en: His words seemed to enrage the whole group.
examples.text_zh: 他的话似乎激怒了整个群体。

examples.text_en: The beautiful song would enrapture the whole room.
examples.text_zh: 这首优美的歌让满屋的人都陶醉了。

examples.text_en: Her kind words enrapture the young boy.
examples.text_zh: 她亲切的话语让小男孩欣喜若狂。

examples.text_en: The enrolment of new students starts next week.
examples.text_zh: 新生的注册下周开始。

examples.text_en: Their school saw a large enrolment this year.
examples.text_zh: 他们学校今年招生人数很多。

examples.text_en: She would ensconce herself in a warm room.
examples.text_zh: 她会把自己安顿在一个暖和的房间里。

examples.text_en: They ensconce the old man near the fire.
examples.text_zh: 他们把老人安置在炉火旁。

examples.text_en: The whole ensemble played well at the great event.
examples.text_zh: 整个乐团在那场盛会上演奏得很出色。

examples.text_en: She wore a fine ensemble to the evening party.
examples.text_zh: 她穿着一套漂亮的礼服去参加晚宴。

examples.text_en: The old law will enshrine the rights of all.
examples.text_zh: 这部旧法律将把所有人的权利固定下来。

examples.text_en: They enshrine his name in the great book.
examples.text_zh: 他们把他的名字珍藏在这本大书里。

examples.text_en: The ensign was raised over the old ship.
examples.text_zh: 那面旗在老船上升了起来。

examples.text_en: A young ensign led the small group home.
examples.text_zh: 一位年轻的海军少尉带领小队回家。

examples.text_en: They tried to enslave the people of the town.
examples.text_zh: 他们想奴役镇上的百姓。

examples.text_en: Fear can enslave a man and take his hope.
examples.text_zh: 恐惧能奴役一个人，夺走他的希望。

examples.text_en: The old net would ensnare the small fish.
examples.text_zh: 旧网会网住那些小鱼。

examples.text_en: They tried to ensnare him with fine words.
examples.text_zh: 他们想用漂亮话诱他落入圈套。

examples.text_en: A long talk would ensue after the great news.
examples.text_zh: 这个重大消息之后会有一场长谈。

examples.text_en: Hard times may ensue if we do nothing now.
examples.text_zh: 如果我们现在什么都不做，艰难的日子可能接踵而至。

examples.text_en: This work will entail many long and hard days.
examples.text_zh: 这项工作需要付出许多漫长而辛苦的日子。

examples.text_en: The new plan may entail a change of place.
examples.text_zh: 新计划可能需要换个地方。

examples.text_en: The long line would entangle the two boats.
examples.text_zh: 长绳子会把两条船缠在一起。

examples.text_en: He did not want to entangle her in this.
examples.text_zh: 他不想把她卷进这件事。

examples.text_en: The entanglement of the lines took some time.
examples.text_zh: 解开这些缠绕的绳子花了一些时间。

examples.text_en: He kept out of the entanglement of the group.
examples.text_zh: 他没有卷入这个团体的纷争。

examples.text_en: She is an enterprising young woman with big plans.
examples.text_zh: 她是个有魄力的年轻女子，胸怀大计。

examples.text_en: The enterprising man started a new business.
examples.text_zh: 这个有进取心的男人开创了一番新事业。

examples.text_en: The entertainer made the children laugh all night.
examples.text_zh: 这位艺人让孩子们笑了一整晚。

examples.text_en: A famous entertainer came to our small town.
examples.text_zh: 一位著名的艺人来到我们的小镇。

examples.text_en: The story would enthral the children for hours.
examples.text_zh: 这个故事会让孩子们着迷好几个小时。

examples.text_en: Her voice seemed to enthral the whole room.
examples.text_zh: 她的嗓音似乎让满屋的人都听得入迷。

examples.text_en: The old song would enthrall everyone at the party.
examples.text_zh: 这首老歌会让聚会上的每个人都着迷。

examples.text_en: He tried to enthrall us with a long story.
examples.text_zh: 他想用一个很长的故事把我们迷住。

examples.text_en: The film was enthralling from first to last.
examples.text_zh: 这部电影从头到尾都很吸引人。

examples.text_en: She told an enthralling story about the old sea.
examples.text_zh: 她讲了一个关于古老海洋的迷人故事。

examples.text_en: They tried to entice him with a big offer.
examples.text_zh: 他们想用优厚的条件引诱他。

examples.text_en: The fine light can entice people into the store.
examples.text_zh: 明亮的灯光能把人吸引进店里。

examples.text_en: He read the entirety of the long report.
examples.text_zh: 他读完了这份长报告的全部内容。

examples.text_en: The entirety of the plan was kept in secret.
examples.text_zh: 整个计划的全部内容都被保密。

examples.text_en: This note will entitle you to a free book.
examples.text_zh: 这张凭证将使你有权得到一本赠书。

examples.text_en: They will entitle the new film with her name.
examples.text_zh: 他们会用她的名字给这部新电影命名。

examples.text_en: The company is a single entity in the market.
examples.text_zh: 这家公司在市场上是一个单一的实体。

examples.text_en: They treated the group as one entity.
examples.text_zh: 他们把这个群体当作一个整体。

examples.text_en: The king came with a large entourage.
examples.text_zh: 国王带着大批随行人员来了。

examples.text_en: Her whole entourage waited outside the door.
examples.text_zh: 她的全体随行人员都在门外等候。

examples.text_en: The music was entrancing and we stayed for hours.
examples.text_zh: 音乐令人神魂颠倒，我们待了好几个小时。

examples.text_en: She has an entrancing way of telling a story.
examples.text_zh: 她讲故事的方式令人着迷。

examples.text_en: They tried to entrap him with a false offer.
examples.text_zh: 他们想用一个虚假的承诺诱骗他。

examples.text_en: The old net would entrap the small fish.
examples.text_zh: 旧网会捕住那些小鱼。

examples.text_en: She would entreat him to stay a little longer.
examples.text_zh: 她会恳求他多待一会儿。

examples.text_en: They entreat us for help in the hard times.
examples.text_zh: 在艰难的日子里，他们恳求我们帮忙。

examples.text_en: Her entreaty moved the old man to help.
examples.text_zh: 她的恳求让老人动了恻隐之心，出手相助。

examples.text_en: He paid no attention to our entreaty.
examples.text_zh: 他对我们的恳求置之不理。

examples.text_en: The new rules would entrench the power of a few.
examples.text_zh: 新规则会让少数人的权力更加牢固。

examples.text_en: They tried to entrench their position in the town.
examples.text_zh: 他们设法在镇上巩固自己的地位。

examples.text_en: The old rules were deeply entrenched in the school.
examples.text_zh: 这些旧规矩在学校里根深蒂固。

examples.text_en: His ideas are entrenched and hard to change.
examples.text_zh: 他的想法根深蒂固，很难改变。

examples.text_en: The two lines would entwine around the old tree.
examples.text_zh: 两根绳子会缠绕在那棵老树上。

examples.text_en: Their lives began to entwine over the years.
examples.text_zh: 这些年来，他们的生活开始交织在一起。

examples.text_en: Please enunciate the rules to the whole class.
examples.text_zh: 请向全班明确说明这些规则。

examples.text_en: He tried to enunciate his plan in a few words.
examples.text_zh: 他设法用几句话把自己的计划讲清楚。

examples.text_en: High walls environ the old house and its field.
examples.text_zh: 高墙环绕着那座老房子和它的田地。

examples.text_en: Green trees environ the small town on all sides.
examples.text_zh: 绿树从四面八方环绕着这座小镇。

examples.text_en: They live in the quiet environs of the city.
examples.text_zh: 他们住在城市安静的郊外。

examples.text_en: We walked through the environs of the old town.
examples.text_zh: 我们走过古镇的郊外。

examples.text_en: We can envisage a better life for the children.
examples.text_zh: 我们可以想象孩子们会有更好的生活。

examples.text_en: He could not envisage a world without music.
examples.text_zh: 他无法想象一个没有音乐的世界。

examples.text_en: She would envision a small house near the sea.
examples.text_zh: 她常常想象海边的一座小房子。

examples.text_en: They envision great changes in the next year.
examples.text_zh: 他们预想明年会有很大的变化。

examples.text_en: The envoy came to talk with the old king.
examples.text_zh: 特使前来与老王会谈。

examples.text_en: A special envoy was sent to the east.
examples.text_zh: 一位特使被派往东方。

examples.text_en: This enzyme helps the body use its food.
examples.text_zh: 这种酶帮助身体利用食物。

examples.text_en: They found a new enzyme in the old water.
examples.text_zh: 他们在旧水里发现了一种新的酶。

examples.text_en: The gold epaulet showed his place in the army.
examples.text_zh: 金色的肩章表明他在军中的身份。

examples.text_en: A bright epaulet was on his left side.
examples.text_zh: 他左侧佩戴着一枚明亮的肩章。

examples.text_en: The beauty of the light was ephemeral and brief.
examples.text_zh: 那光影的美短暂而瞬逝。

examples.text_en: Fame can be ephemeral in the world of art.
examples.text_zh: 在艺术界，名声可能是短暂的。

examples.text_en: The epicure knows every fine place in the city.
examples.text_zh: 这位美食家对城里的好去处了如指掌。

examples.text_en: He was a real epicure and loved good food.
examples.text_zh: 他是个真正的美食家，特别喜欢美味。

examples.text_en: The epicurean spent his money on fine food.
examples.text_zh: 这位享乐主义者把钱都花在了美食上。

examples.text_en: They led an epicurean life of music and rest.
examples.text_zh: 他们过着有音乐和休憩的享乐生活。

examples.text_en: The epidermis is the outer part of the skin.
examples.text_zh: 表皮是皮肤的外层部分。

examples.text_en: A small cut can hurt the epidermis.
examples.text_zh: 一道小伤口就能伤到表皮。

examples.text_en: He wrote an epigram about the proud king.
examples.text_zh: 他写了一首嘲讽那位傲慢国王的警句诗。

examples.text_en: The old book is full of epigram and wit.
examples.text_zh: 这本旧书里满是警句和机智。

examples.text_en: The epilogue brought the long story to an end.
examples.text_zh: 尾声为这个长长的故事画上了句号。

examples.text_en: He wrote the epilogue in a few short lines.
examples.text_zh: 他用短短的几行写了这个尾声。

examples.text_en: The film was episodic and hard to follow.
examples.text_zh: 这部电影像是由一段段插曲组成，很难看明白。

examples.text_en: His work was episodic and lacked a clear line.
examples.text_zh: 他的作品像一段段插曲，缺少清晰的线索。

examples.text_en: The epitaph on the stone was short and kind.
examples.text_zh: 石碑上的墓志铭简短而温和。

examples.text_en: He wrote a fine epitaph for his old friend.
examples.text_zh: 他为老朋友写了一段很好的碑文。

examples.text_en: The boys gave him an unkind epithet.
examples.text_zh: 孩子们给他起了个难听的绰号。

examples.text_en: That epithet has followed him for many years.
examples.text_zh: 那个绰号跟了他许多年。

examples.text_en: She is the epitome of a good teacher.
examples.text_zh: 她是一位好老师的典范。

examples.text_en: The small town was the epitome of quiet life.
examples.text_zh: 这座小镇是宁静生活的缩影。

examples.text_en: This short line can epitomize the whole idea.
examples.text_zh: 这一短句就能概括整个想法。

examples.text_en: He tried to epitomize the report in a page.
examples.text_zh: 他设法把报告概括成一页。

examples.text_en: The new machine began a whole new epoch.
examples.text_zh: 这台新机器开启了一个全新的时代。

examples.text_en: They lived in a great epoch of change.
examples.text_zh: 他们生活在一个巨变的伟大时代。

examples.text_en: The money was shared equally between the friends.
examples.text_zh: 钱在几个朋友之间平分了。

examples.text_en: All the children were treated equally at school.
examples.text_zh: 所有孩子在学校都受到同等对待。

examples.text_en: She took the bad news with great equanimity.
examples.text_zh: 她非常镇定地接受了这个坏消息。

examples.text_en: He faced the loss with equanimity and hope.
examples.text_zh: 他平静而充满希望地面对损失。

examples.text_en: The equestrian show drew a big group of people.
examples.text_zh: 这场马术表演吸引了一大群人。

examples.text_en: He learned equestrian skills from his old friend.
examples.text_zh: 他从老朋友那里学到了马术。

examples.text_en: The old picture showed a strong equine form.
examples.text_zh: 那幅旧画上画着一匹健壮的马。

examples.text_en: They studied the equine body in the science class.
examples.text_zh: 他们在科学课上研究马的身体结构。

examples.text_en: The whole equipe came to the big game.
examples.text_zh: 整个运动队都来参加这场大赛。

examples.text_en: Their equipe worked well as a single team.
examples.text_zh: 他们的运动队配合得像一个整体。

examples.text_en: We need an equitable answer for both sides.
examples.text_zh: 我们需要一个对双方都公平的解决办法。

examples.text_en: The old king tried to be equitable to all.
examples.text_zh: 老国王努力做到对所有人公正。

examples.text_en: They asked for equity in the new law.
examples.text_zh: 他们要求新法律体现公平。

examples.text_en: The judge spoke about equity and the common good.
examples.text_zh: 法官谈到了公平与共同的利益。

examples.text_en: His answer was equivocal and helped no one.
examples.text_zh: 他的回答模棱两可，谁也帮不了。

examples.text_en: The words of the note were equivocal to us.
examples.text_zh: 便条上的话在我们看来意义不明。

examples.text_en: He would equivocate when we asked him directly.
examples.text_zh: 我们直接问他时，他就支支吾吾。

examples.text_en: Do not equivocate about the time of the meeting.
examples.text_zh: 不要对会议时间含糊其辞。

examples.text_en: His equivocation made the whole group doubt him.
examples.text_zh: 他含糊其辞的话让整个团队都对他起疑。

examples.text_en: They were tired of his equivocation and delays.
examples.text_zh: 他们厌倦了他的含糊其辞和拖延。

examples.text_en: They worked hard to eradicate the old problem.
examples.text_zh: 他们努力根除这个老问题。

examples.text_en: We can eradicate this illness in a few years.
examples.text_zh: 我们能在几年内消灭这种疾病。

examples.text_en: The erasure of his name was soon found.
examples.text_zh: 他名字被擦掉的事很快就被发现了。

examples.text_en: A small erasure had changed the whole note.
examples.text_zh: 一处小小的擦痕改变了整张便条的内容。

examples.text_zh: 土地受到的侵蚀大家有目共睹。

examples.text_en: Water can cause the erosion of the old road.
examples.text_zh: 水会造成老路的侵蚀。

examples.text_zh: 这个古怪的人一言不发地来了又走。

examples.text_zh: 他们叫那老人怪人，然后走开了。

examples.text_zh: 那辆旧车一路不稳地向前开。

examples.text_zh: 他工作没有规律，缺勤很多天。

examples.text_zh: 他错误的想法惹来了不少麻烦。

examples.text_zh: 这种代用品很便宜，却毫无味道。

examples.text_zh: 他们用代用品代替了真品。

examples.text_zh: 从前的朋友多年后又见面了。

examples.text_zh: 他满怀深情地谈起从前的家。

examples.text_zh: 这位博学的老师对古书很熟悉。

examples.text_en: She is an erudite woman with a fine mind.
examples.text_zh: 她是个博学的女子，头脑很好。

examples.text_zh: 那场大火的爆发让我们都很吃惊。

examples.text_en: A sudden eruption changed the whole land.
examples.text_zh: 一次突然的爆发改变了整片土地。

examples.text_zh: 这场小争执可能逐步升级成大打出手。

examples.text_en: We must stop the escalation of these prices.
examples.text_zh: 我们必须阻止这些价格的不断上涨。

examples.text_en: He read fine books for a little escapism.
examples.text_zh: 他读些好书，用来短暂地逃避现实。

examples.text_en: Their escapism worried the old teacher.
examples.text_zh: 他们逃避现实的态度让老教师担忧。

examples.text_en: The film was pure escapist fun for the whole family.
examples.text_zh: 这部电影是全家都能享受的纯娱乐。

examples.text_en: He took an escapist way out of his problems.
examples.text_zh: 他用逃避的方式摆脱自己的问题。

examples.text_en: They eschew fine words and ask for hard facts.
examples.text_zh: 他们避开漂亮话，只求确凿的事实。

examples.text_en: He would eschew the city for a quiet life.
examples.text_zh: 他会远离城市，去过安静的生活。

examples.text_en: The escort stayed with her through the long night.
examples.text_zh: 护卫整夜都陪着她。

examples.text_en: A small escort led the group to the city.
examples.text_zh: 一小队护卫把人群领到城里。

examples.text_en: Food moves down the esophagus to the body.
examples.text_zh: 食物顺着食道进入身体。

examples.text_en: The doctor looked at his esophagus with care.
examples.text_zh: 医生仔细检查了他的食道。

examples.text_en: The book tells of esoteric ideas and old ways.
examples.text_zh: 这本书讲的是深奥的思想和古老的做法。

examples.text_en: His esoteric words were hard for us to follow.
examples.text_zh: 他那些高深的话我们难以听懂。

examples.text_en: His espousal of the new idea surprised us all.
examples.text_zh: 他对新想法的拥护让我们都很吃惊。

examples.text_en: They held the espousal in the old church.
examples.text_zh: 他们在老教堂里举行了婚礼。

examples.text_en: We could espy the old house from the hill.
examples.text_zh: 我们从山丘上能望见那座老房子。

examples.text_en: He tried to espy a way out of the room.
examples.text_zh: 他设法察看从房间里出去的路。

examples.text_en: The establishment of the new school took years.
examples.text_zh: 新学校的建立花了好几年。

examples.text_en: They met at a small establishment near the sea.
examples.text_zh: 他们在海边一家小场所见了面。

examples.text_en: The old estate passed to his only daughter.
examples.text_zh: 这份旧产业传给了他唯一的女儿。

examples.text_en: He left his whole estate to the small school.
examples.text_zh: 他把全部财产留给了那所小学校。

examples.text_en: The students held him in high esteem.
examples.text_zh: 学生们十分敬重他。

examples.text_en: Her work won the esteem of the whole town.
examples.text_zh: 她的工作赢得了全镇人的尊敬。

examples.text_en: The room had a fine esthetic quality about it.
examples.text_zh: 这个房间有一种雅致的审美格调。

examples.text_en: They talked about the esthetic side of the design.
examples.text_zh: 他们谈论了这个设计的审美一面。

examples.text_en: He was an estimable man and a true friend.
examples.text_zh: 他是一位可敬的人，也是个真诚的朋友。

examples.text_en: The estimable teacher helped the poor for years.
examples.text_zh: 这位可敬的老师帮助穷人许多年。

examples.text_en: The long fight would estrange the two brothers.
examples.text_zh: 这场长期的争执会让两兄弟疏远。

examples.text_en: He did not want to estrange his old friends.
examples.text_zh: 他不想和老朋友们疏远。
